description: LLM-Assisted Options Trading Copilot - Discipline and time compression for options traders with compliance-first approach

userStories.notes: Completed: Created directory structure (src/api, src/ui, src/services, src/adapters, src/storage, src/types), package.json with TypeScript + Vitest, tsconfig.json with strict mode, .gitignore for secrets, .env.example template, README.md with architecture diagram. Typecheck and tests pass.

userStories.title: Broker adapter interface
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a unified broker adapter interface so I can support multiple brokers with consistent code.
acceptanceCriteria: Define TypeScript interface for broker operations (positions, orders, quotes, chains)
Include methods: getPositions(), getOpenOrders(), getQuote(), getOptionChain(), placeOrder(), cancelOrder()
Document expected error types and rate limits
Add adapter factory pattern for broker selection
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed: Created BrokerAdapter interface in src/types/broker.ts with full type definitions for positions, orders, quotes, option chains, and Greeks. Added comprehensive error types (BrokerError, AuthenticationError, RateLimitError, OrderError) in src/types/errors.ts. Documented rate limits for Alpaca, Tradier, tastytrade, and IBKR in src/types/rate-limits.ts. Implemented adapter factory pattern in src/adapters/broker-factory.ts with register/create functions and config validation. Added 15 passing tests. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Secure credential storage
userStories.description: As a user, I need my broker API credentials stored securely so they cannot be exposed in logs or code.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement secrets vault or encrypted storage (e.g., AWS Secrets Manager, Doppler, or encrypted JSON)
Never log tokens or secrets
Implement token refresh logic for OAuth providers
Add credential validation on startup
Document setup process in README
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed: Implemented AES-256-GCM encrypted storage for broker credentials in src/storage/. Created SecretManager class with: (1) encryption.ts - AES-256-GCM encryption with PBKDF2 key derivation, maskSecret() for safe logging; (2) token-refresh.ts - OAuth token refresh logic with broker-specific handlers for Tradier; (3) secrets.ts - SecretManager class handling encrypted persistence, credential validation per broker type, auto token refresh, and safe credential info for logging. Never logs secrets - uses maskSecret() throughout. Added 22 tests for storage layer (37 total tests pass). Updated README with comprehensive secure credential setup documentation. Updated .gitignore to exclude .secrets/ directory. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Connect to broker (read-only, single broker MVP)
userStories.description: As a user, I want to connect my broker account so the system can read my portfolio.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement OAuth or token-based authentication for chosen broker
Successfully retrieve and display account balance and buying power
Handle auth errors gracefully with user-friendly messages
Store tokens securely using US-003 infrastructure
Add disconnect functionality
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed: Implemented Tradier broker adapter (src/adapters/tradier/) with full BrokerAdapter interface. Features: (1) Token-based authentication using access tokens stored securely via SecretManager; (2) Account summary retrieval with balance, buying power, P&L; (3) Position and order fetching with proper type mapping; (4) Market data quotes and option chains with Greeks; (5) Graceful auth error handling with user-friendly messages (AuthenticationError, RateLimitError); (6) Disconnect functionality clears sensitive data. Created BrokerConnectionService (src/services/) for high-level connection management integrating SecretManager. Added 42 new tests (79 total). Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Risk configuration storage

acceptanceCriteria: Create config schema: max risk per trade (%), max risk per underlying (%), max daily loss ($), max open positions (count), max contracts per position, allowed DTE range (min/max days)

userStories.notes: Completed: Created src/types/risk-config.ts with complete RiskConfig type and Zod validation schema covering: maxRiskPerTradePercent (0-100), maxRiskPerUnderlyingPercent (0-100), maxDailyLoss ($), maxOpenPositions (count), maxContractsPerPosition, minDTE/maxDTE for allowed DTE range. Includes StoredRiskConfig for persistence with id, accountId, createdAt, updatedAt, name, isActive. Created RiskConfigService (src/services/risk-config.ts) with full CRUD: createConfig, updateConfig, deleteConfig, setActiveConfig, getActiveConfig, getAllConfigs. Configs stored encrypted per account in .config/risk/. Validation includes cross-field check (minDTE < maxDTE) plus warnings for aggressive settings. Added DEFAULT_RISK_CONFIG for new accounts. formatRiskConfigForDisplay() helper for UI. Added 31 passing tests (110 total). Typecheck passes. Note: UI form and dashboard display will be implemented in US-008 (Basic dashboard UI).

userStories.title: Fetch option chains
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to retrieve option chains so the system can analyze available strikes and expirations.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement getOptionChain(symbol, minDTE, maxDTE) in broker adapter
Return strikes, expirations, bid/ask, volume, open interest
Include Greeks (delta, theta, vega, gamma) and IV when available from broker
Cache chain data with TTL (5-15 minutes)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed: Created MarketDataService (src/services/market-data.ts) that wraps BrokerAdapter to provide caching. Features: (1) Option chain caching with configurable TTL (default 10 minutes, within 5-15 min requirement); (2) Quote caching with shorter TTL (1 minute); (3) LRU-style eviction when cache reaches max size; (4) Cache statistics (hits, misses, hit rate); (5) Symbol-specific cache invalidation; (6) forceRefresh option to bypass cache. The underlying getOptionChain() was already implemented in US-004's Tradier adapter with full support for strikes, expirations, bid/ask, volume, OI, and Greeks (delta, gamma, theta, vega, IV). Added 22 passing tests for cache behavior. Typecheck passes (132 total tests pass).
